note: COUNTS ONLY. Batch 3 of real (vulnerable function, fixed function) pairs whose function survives the fix, mined at zero model cost from reviewed GitHub advisories (pip, npm, maven, composer) and added as pointer-pair corpus benchmarks/pairs/advisory-fixes-3 (source `advisory-fixes-3` in learn/sources.toml); labelled, given static feature records, built into the memory store and embedded. No chat-model call, no Docker, no Joern. Candidate, path, function and repository names stay in the catalog; the pairs the reserved-population guard flagged are withheld (found by bisection with the test output discarded; names never printed).

method.enumeration: gh api /advisories?type=reviewed&ecosystem=<eco>&cwes=<family CWEs>&published=>2023-01-01 per ecosystem (pip, npm, maven, composer) x six compiled families; Go, Ruby and C# not enumerated; newest first
method.automated_screen: as batch 2 (single family by CWE; linked fix commit, at most 3, one repository; repository not named anywhere under benchmarks/ incl. batches 1-2; excluded v3 file names never opened; no WordPress plugin; one pair per repository; SPDX licence permissive; one-parent commit; the function holding most changed code lines inside its own matcher span, declared once on both sides, body changed, >= 25% of the file's changed code lines) plus three widenings: (a) an advisory linking only a merged pull request uses its single commit or its squash/rebase merge commit; (b) commits of up to 6 non-test source files / 240 changed lines (batch 2: 4 / 120); (c) a second pass over advisories whose CWEs span two families, the family then chosen from the function's diff on review
method.file_reads: commit metadata and the two versions of each changed source file through the contents API into scratch (no clone, no scanner, engine, plane Run or model on these repositories); scratch deleted after
method.manual_review: every automated candidate's in-function diff read (agent, no model call); kept only when the named function itself holds the fix; a weak inline check replaced by a stronger helper call counts as the fix, a function that only forwards a flag or calls a fix made elsewhere does not
method.reserved_population_guard: pytest -q tests/ -k 'reserved or v3' with output discarded, bisected over catalog subsets (18 runs; baseline with an empty batch green); final catalog green
method.rename_check: canonical full_name of every kept repository from the API: no two kept pairs share a repository, none renamed into a name the benchmarks use
method.mechanism: family default as batch 2 (injection/output_encoding/deserialization source_reaches_sink, path path_join_user_input, access_control missing_auth_guard, untrusted_destination validation_strength for CWE-601 else source_reaches_sink); provenance = agent

screened.outcomes_note: single-family pass (screen 2, every advisory examined, no quota met) plus the two-family pass; `kept` = automated candidates; `manual review: the chosen function does not hold the fix (comment-only, misattributed, partial or family mismatch)` = the screen re-meeting a function the 2026-10-03 review had dropped

targets.asked: injection and untrusted_destination >= 60 each; path, access_control, output_encoding, deserialization >= 30 where advisories allow; >= 250 total
targets.limit: the reviewed-advisory pool, not the review: every advisory since 2023-01-01 in the four ecosystems was examined; the post-cutoff pool was largely spent by batch 2 (its repositories are now excluded), and untrusted_destination/access_control/deserialization advisories mostly lack a linked single fix commit or sit in repositories the benchmarks already use

features.command: benchmarks/learn/build_features.py --labels <the 1004 new rows> --units <merged units.json of `ousast plane harvest --catalog benchmarks/pairs/advisory-fixes-3/catalog.toml` (manifests written, no Run started)> --catalog benchmarks/pairs/advisory-fixes-3/catalog.toml --kinds pairs
features.note: quick rules and deterministic roles ran on each side; engine, verify, agree and model sinks never ran for these pairs (missing/none: null features, never zeros)

memory_build.command: ousast learn memory build --labels <labels> --units <merged units.json> --profile static --root . (exit 2: adjudications 9 of 43 anonymous functions, unchanged since 2026-10-01; rows kept)

complete_pairs.how: store example rows (profile static) keyed as learn.experiments.freeze_units pairs them: (repo, candidate, family) holding both labels; whole memory, every family
